title: Leandro meets Thierry Jamin and the Inca Institute takes up research

tellings.quote: In 2016, he met a French explorer of ancient Incan lost cities named Thierry Jamin.

plain: In 2016 a man named Leandro, linked to the strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru's Nazca region, met a French explorer of lost Inca cities named Thierry Jamin, whose research group, the Inca Institute, then took up study of the finds. Michels tells this himself while laying out how the bodies came to scientific attention.
